firm_archetypes: Independent multi-office residential brokerages (50–400 affiliated agents) operating across 1–5 MLSs
Franchise affiliates (e.g., RE/MAX, Keller Williams, Century 21) with local ownership and franchise reporting obligations
Cloud-first brokerages with local teams (‘teamerage’ structure) and distributed admin staff
Regional boutique brands with high split, cap-based compensation and in-house transaction coordination
buyer_roles: Managing Broker / Broker of Record (compliance oversight, file review, E&O risk)
COO / Director of Operations (workflow, systems, handoffs)
Controller / Back Office Manager (trust accounting, commissions, 1099s, franchise reporting)
Head of Recruiting / Agent Services (onboarding, retention, productivity enablement)
Marketing/Lead Gen Ops (lead routing, attribution, ROI)
operating_characteristics: Predominantly 1099 independent contractor agents; brokerage runs trust/escrow accounts, commission disbursements, agent billing (dues/fees) and year-end 1099-NEC
Front office stack: IDX websites + CRM + lead routing + call/text; common platforms include kvCORE, BoomTown, Chime, Follow Up Boss, MoxiWorks
Mid-office: transaction management + forms + e-sign + compliance (Lone Wolf Transactions zipForm Edition; dotloop; SkySlope; DocuSign Rooms; Paperless Pipeline)
Back office: commissions automation + trust accounting + agent billing (Lone Wolf Back Office; Brokermint; iBroker with QuickBooks Online)
MLS-centric listing workflow; showing scheduling via ShowingTime; access control via Supra/Sentrilock; listing syndication via ListHub/IDX
Commission plans vary by agent/team with caps, sliding scales, team splits, referrals, lead-source fees

workflow_map.current_process: Leads from portals (Zillow Premier Agent, Realtor.com), paid ads, referral/form fills, IDX websites enter CRM; rules route based on source/geography/round-robin; auto-text/email/call sequences kick off; ‘speed to lead’ targets often set via CRM metrics; Zillow playbooks emphasize rapid response.
common_tools: kvCORE (Inside Real Estate) with Brokermint integration
Follow Up Boss (lead routing, speed-to-lead tracking)
manual_steps: Tuning routing rules to match team availability
Monitoring missed calls/unclaimed leads
Manually updating contact/lead stage notes when agents bypass CRM
pain_points: Slow or inconsistent speed-to-lead and re-assignment
workflow_map.why_painful: Contact rate and conversion decay rapidly with slow response; routing fairness impacts morale and retention; missed SLAs reduce portal ROI.
workflow_map.business_impact: Lower conversion to appointments and GCI; wasted portal/ad spend; internal conflict over lead credits. Evidence: Zillow Premier Agent Conversion Playbook stresses rapid outreach and KPI tracking (Zillow PDF, Oct 2023).

workflow_map.current_process: Agent prepares listing agreement using state forms (zipForm/dotloop) and obtains e-signatures; collects property data, photos, and disclosures; enters listing into MLS; enables ShowingTime ‘Schedule a Showing’ button; configures lockbox (Supra/Sentrilock).
manual_steps: Writing public remarks compliant with Fair Housing
Uploading media to MLS and copying to marketing sites if not integrated
Setting up showing instructions, contacts and lockbox codes
pain_points: Time-consuming listing copy creation with Fair Housing compliance checks
Duplication entering data across MLS, CRM and marketing tools when integrations are partial
workflow_map.why_painful: Manual content creation under compliance constraints (e.g., Fair Housing advertising rules) and duplicate data entry increases error risk and delays go-live.
workflow_map.business_impact: Slower time-to-market and inconsistent listing data; compliance exposure in public remarks. Evidence: Fair Housing ad guidance from MLS/associations (NorthstarMLS 2024; SmartMLS word/phrase lists; 24 CFR Part 100). ShowingTime MLS integration enables in-MLS scheduling.

workflow_map.current_process: Agents schedule tours via ShowingTime; buyer pre-approval/criteria tracked in CRM; Supra/Sentrilock app unlocks lockboxes; feedback requests sent post-showing.
manual_steps: Coordinating multi-property tour routes and calendar holds
Following up on feedback not auto-returned
pain_points: Fragmented feedback collection across MLS territories
workflow_map.why_painful: Back-and-forth confirmations lead to missed windows; fragmented systems across MLSs limit unified reporting.
workflow_map.business_impact: Agent time loss; weaker seller reporting.

workflow_map.current_process: State association forms via zipForm/dotloop; e-sign (DocuSign/DigiSign); offer submission; negotiation; acceptance triggers creation of transaction file with checklists and deadlines.
manual_steps: Ensuring correct form versions/addenda for each MLS/jurisdiction
Entering deal data across forms and TM system
workflow_map.why_painful: Compliance failures delay acceptance or force amendments; duplicate entry increases error odds.
workflow_map.business_impact: Deal risk; rework; broker liability. Evidence: Lone Wolf zipForm support references compliance review stages and checklists.

workflow_map.current_process: TC builds file checklists; document collection; broker review at staged ‘checkpoints’; automated reminders for missing signatures and deadlines; audit trail maintained; lender/title communications.
common_tools: SkySlope (checklists, Smart Assist, Auto-Split & Assign, audit logs)
Lone Wolf Transactions (zipForm Edition) compliance stages
manual_steps: Chasing missing docs/signatures
Splitting and labeling large PDF packets
Submitting for staged broker reviews
pain_points: High-volume admin follow-ups for missing items
Manual PDF splitting and misfiled documents
workflow_map.why_painful: Human error creates audit exposure and closing friction; repetitive tasks consume TC/broker time.
workflow_map.business_impact: Audit risk, delayed closings, higher admin headcount. Evidence: SkySlope describes AI-driven pre-approval checks and auto-splitting to keep files audit-ready; Lone Wolf outlines compliance stages.

workflow_map.current_process: Back office calculates commissions per plan; prepares and sends Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA) to title/escrow; handles franchise fees, referrals, deductions; earnest money may be digital (e.g., Earnnest ACH).
common_tools: Brokermint (commission automation, accounting, agent billing, MLS/CRM integrations)
Lone Wolf Back Office (commission automation, trust & escrow tracking, MLS integration, franchise tools)
manual_steps: Handling exceptions (team splits, caps reached mid-deal, referral lines)
CDA revisions and re-sends
Reconciling trust accounts
workflow_map.why_painful: Payment errors damage agent trust; misapplied splits/caps require clawbacks; trust errors create regulatory exposure.
workflow_map.business_impact: Cash flow delays, rework, potential fines; agent churn risk. Evidence: Paperless Pipeline details CDA steps/pitfalls and the need for software; Brokermint and Lone Wolf highlight commission automation, trust tracking; Earnnest reduces check/wire risks.

workflow_map.current_process: Deal posts to accounting; agent billing for monthly fees; franchise reporting; dashboards on profitability and agent performance; prepare 1099 at year-end.
common_tools: Lone Wolf Back Office (month/year-end, 1099 e-file, reporting)
manual_steps: Manual exports to QuickBooks if using non-integrated stack
End-of-year 1099 corrections for agent SSN/addresses
workflow_map.why_painful: Duplicate entry and mismatched ledgers create closing-period crunch and errors; 1099 penalties for incorrect/late filings.
workflow_map.business_impact: Staff overtime, error corrections, audit trails. Evidence: Lone Wolf support docs on preparing/printing/e-filing 1099s; iBroker FAQ details reliance on QuickBooks Online.

workflow_map.current_process: Recruiting pipeline tracking; offers; onboarding includes license verification, Independent Contractor Agreement, W-9, E&O proof, MLS/association transfer, tool account creation, adding to back office/CRM/MLS.
manual_steps: Cross-system account creation and permissions
License and E&O verifications
Agent tech stack training
pain_points: Fragmented onboarding across MLS, CRM, back office, showing tools
workflow_map.why_painful: Delayed productivity and risk if agents transact without proper setup; high variance in process quality.
workflow_map.business_impact: Lost early production; preventable compliance issues. Evidence: NAR Magazine outlines step-by-step onboarding benefits; iBroker recruiting features.

likely_vendors: kvCORE (Inside Real Estate; integrated with Brokermint back office)
technology_map.job_to_be_done: Capture, route, and nurture leads; provide IDX websites; track speed-to-lead and conversion; enable omni-channel outreach.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Agents bypass CRM; fragmented attribution; integration gaps to transaction/back office lead to duplicate entry.

likely_vendors: SkySlope (with DigiSign, Smart Assist, Auto-Split & Assign)
technology_map.job_to_be_done: Create transaction files; populate state forms; obtain signatures; maintain checklists; broker compliance review; audit logs.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Missing docs/signatures; PDF packet splitting; inconsistent use by agents; review queues bottleneck.

technology_map.category: Back office: commissions, trust accounting, billing, reporting
technology_map.job_to_be_done: Automate complex commission plans; track trust/escrow; generate CDAs; agent billing; franchise reporting; dashboards; 1099s.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Edge-case commission math (teams, mid-deal cap crossing, referral chains); manual CDA adjustments; reconcile with QuickBooks.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Schedule/confirm showings; coordinate access; log access history.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Reschedules and seller constraints; feedback capture inconsistency across MLSs.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Distribute MLS listings to portals/publisher network and broker sites.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Metadata mismatches; contact/branding errors; lag in updates.

technology_map.job_to_be_done: Collect earnest money digitally; reduce check/wire fraud risk; route to correct escrow.
technology_map.where_it_breaks: Parties outside supported title/escrow networks; education/uptake gaps.

pain_point_map.pain: Slow/uneven speed-to-lead and missed lead SLAs
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Agent adoption varies; CRM automations misaligned with schedules; competing sources with different SLAs.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Manual monitoring, re-assigning cold leads, phone trees.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Doesn’t scale and still depends on agent behavior.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Lower contact/appointment rates; wasted portal/ad spend; lost GCI. Reference: Zillow Premier Agent conversion guidance emphasizes rapid response.

pain_point_map.pain: Duplicate data entry across MLS, CRM, transaction and back office
pain_point_map.where_in_workflow: Listing intake; offer creation; posting to accounting
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Heterogeneous stacks and partial integrations across MLS territories; human preference for familiar tools.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Introduces errors and delays; breaks audit trails.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: 2–6 hours per transaction coordinator per week lost; rework costs.

pain_point_map.pain: Compliance document chase and file readiness for audit
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Agent variability; many parties and forms; state-specific requirements; PDF packet sprawl.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Manual reminders, checklists, hand review, PDF splitting/labeling.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Error-prone and time-consuming; bottlenecks at broker review.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Admin headcount; audit risk; delayed closings. Evidence: SkySlope Smart Assist and Auto-Split & Assign tackle this because it’s pervasive.

pain_point_map.pain: Commission miscalculations on complex plans (caps, teams, referrals, franchise fees)
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Edge cases exceed plan templates; late changes to price/credits; referrals and fees handled inconsistently.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Controller edits payout statements manually; multiple CDA revisions with title.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: High error risk; rework; distrust if under/overpaid.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Cash leakage, agent dissatisfaction, time-to-pay delays. Evidence: Paperless Pipeline CDA guide highlights complexity; Brokermint and Lone Wolf market commission automation due to this pain.

pain_point_map.pain: CDA errors or timing issues causing delayed or misdirected payments
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Manual population and late-stage changes; limited validation against plan/ledger.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Email revised CDAs to title; holdbacks/clawbacks post-close.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Creates reconciliation mess; reputational damage with agents.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Agent churn risk; hours of rework; possible trust accounting issues.

pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Multiple banks/escrow accounts; fragmented data from TM/back office; manual deposits when not using digital tools.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: High error potential and audit risk.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Overtime during close; regulatory exposure. Lone Wolf Back Office sells trust & escrow tracking to mitigate this.

pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Agent data quality (SSN/EIN/addresses); multiple systems; late updates.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Manual cleanup in back office; QuickBooks exports; paper mailings.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Seasonal workload spike; potential IRS penalties. Evidence: Lone Wolf support docs detail preparing/printing/e-filing 1099s.

pain_point_map.pain: Onboarding fragmentation across MLS, CRM, back office, showings
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Each system has separate provisioning and role models; MLS/association steps external.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Slow time-to-first-commission; misses create compliance gaps.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Lost early production; higher support load. Evidence: NAR onboarding guidance; iBroker recruiting module.

pain_point_map.pain: Listing remarks creation under Fair Housing and MLS constraints
pain_point_map.why_it_persists: Human authorship; variable compliance literacy; MLS character/field rules.
pain_point_map.current_workaround: Manager review; copy from past listings; ad hoc tools.
pain_point_map.why_workaround_fails: Slow and inconsistent; residual compliance risk.
pain_point_map.economic_impact: Delays time-to-market; small but pervasive time sink. Evidence: Fair Housing language resources from MLS/associations.

insider_insights.insight: The CDA is the true control point for cash flow and agent trust; minor errors here outweigh back-office system brand choice.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: Buyers focus on commission ‘automation’ features but underestimate last-mile CDA mismatches with title workflows.
insider_insights.evidence_type: Vendor guides and back-office admin testimonials (Paperless Pipeline CDA guide; Brokermint/Lone Wolf CDA/commission tooling pages).

insider_insights.insight: Agent 1099 status means tool mandates backfire; adoption must be nudged via faster pay, lead priority, or compliance gates.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: Top-down IT rollouts assume W-2 behavior; independent contractors resist if no clear benefit.
insider_insights.evidence_type: Observed across CRM/TM adoption; supported by NAR process guidance and vendor-integrated incentives (e.g., faster ACH via back office).

insider_insights.insight: Team splits often override brokerage plans mid-transaction; systems that don’t model team logic create clawbacks and agent friction.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: Commission structures appear static on paper; in practice, team/lead-source/referral overlays change late.
insider_insights.evidence_type: Back office FAQs (iBroker tiers; Brokermint multi-plan capabilities) and CDA complexity articles.

insider_insights.insight: ‘All-in-one’ marketing claims aside, most $5M–$50M brokerages run heterogeneous stacks across multiple MLSs; integration surface and data hygiene matter more than suite branding.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: Suite vendors market end-to-end workflows; operators balance legacy contracts, agent preferences, and MLS constraints.
insider_insights.evidence_type: kvCORE–Brokermint integration PR; iBroker–QuickBooks Online reliance; ListHub syndication realities.

insider_insights.insight: Compliance review is a staged workflow problem (checkpoints), not just document storage; auto-splitting and pre-approval checks convert real admin hours.
insider_insights.why_non_insiders_miss_it: They reduce TM to ‘e-sign and store’; the bottleneck is staged broker review and missing items.
insider_insights.evidence_type: Lone Wolf zipForm compliance stages; SkySlope Smart Assist and Auto-Split & Assign.

top_ai_use_cases.name: Automated compliance QA and document orchestration
top_ai_use_cases.problem_solved: Missing documents/signatures and misfiled PDFs create audit risk and review bottlenecks.
top_ai_use_cases.current_process: TCs split PDFs, label documents, compare against checklist, and submit staged reviews; broker/auditor manually flags deficiencies.
top_ai_use_cases.workflow_insertion_point: Contract-to-close inside transaction management; pre-review and at each checkpoint.
top_ai_use_cases.roi_logic: Reduce TC/broker time by 30–50% on file prep/review; lower audit exceptions; faster clear-to-close reduces fallouts. Savings realized as avoided admin headcount or capacity redeployment.
top_ai_use_cases.proof_metric: Avg. missing-item count per file; time-to-reviewed-file; % files approved on first pass; audit exception rate.
top_ai_use_cases.why_existing_software_does_not_fully_sol: Native rules/checklists exist, but cross-document reasoning, fuzzy matching (e.g., earnest money evidence tied to addenda), and automated PDF splitting remain partial; vendors like SkySlope have features, but many brokerages run mixed stacks where AI overlay across dotloop/zipForm/DocuSign Rooms is needed. Evidence: SkySlope Smart Assist/Auto-Split; Lone Wolf compliance stages.

top_ai_use_cases.name: Commission plan validation and CDA anomaly detection
top_ai_use_cases.problem_solved: Edge-case commission math and last-minute changes cause payout errors and CDA rework.
top_ai_use_cases.current_process: Controller configures plans and manually edits payout lines and CDAs; limited pre-close validation against plan history and caps/referrals.
top_ai_use_cases.workflow_insertion_point: Pre-CDA generation in back office; on change events (price, credits) from TM.
top_ai_use_cases.roi_logic: Reduce payout errors >80%; cut CDA reissue cycles by 50%; accelerate agent pay (ACH same/next day) improving retention; fewer trust reconciliation adjustments.
top_ai_use_cases.proof_metric: CDA reissue rate; under/overpay incidents; time-to-pay post-close; % exceptions auto-resolved.
top_ai_use_cases.why_existing_software_does_not_fully_sol: Back-office tools automate standard plans, but lack model-based reconciliation to detect anomalies vs. historical patterns, referral chains, and mid-deal cap crossing across disparate data sources. Evidence: Brokermint/Lone Wolf market commission automation because manual exceptions persist; Paperless Pipeline details CDA pitfalls.

top_ai_use_cases.name: Lead response copilot (speed-to-lead and re-routing)
top_ai_use_cases.problem_solved: Slow initial outreach and stalled nurtures reduce conversion and waste portal spend.
top_ai_use_cases.current_process: CRMs trigger templated drips; agents often ignore/circumvent; managers manually reassign.
top_ai_use_cases.workflow_insertion_point: At lead ingress into CRM; monitors agent engagement; escalates or reassigns based on intent signals.
top_ai_use_cases.roi_logic: Increase contact/appointment conversion by 20–40% via sub-60-second outreach and intelligent re-assignment; higher ROI on portals; measurable GCI lift.
top_ai_use_cases.proof_metric: Median first-response time; contact rate; set-appointment rate by source; cost-per-appointment.
top_ai_use_cases.why_existing_software_does_not_fully_sol: CRMs provide automations, but lack adaptive policies that account for agent workload/availability and dynamic buyer intent; cross-source SLA governance and fair-routing are still manual. Evidence: Zillow conversion playbooks stress rapid response; Follow Up Boss positions speed-to-lead and routing as core but adoption gaps persist.

high_confidence: Back-office functions (commission automation, trust accounting, 1099) are handled by Lone Wolf Back Office, Brokermint, or iBroker+QuickBooks Online in this ICP. Sources: Lone Wolf Back Office product page (commission automation, trust & escrow, 1099 support docs); Brokermint back office page; iBroker FAQ on QuickBooks integration.
CDA is a standard artifact instructing title/escrow on payouts; manual CDA processes cause errors/delays. Source: Paperless Pipeline CDA guide.

Transaction management compliance uses staged reviews/checklists; auto-splitting and pre-approval checks address common pain. Sources: Lone Wolf zipForm compliance stages; SkySlope Smart Assist/Auto-Split & Assign blog.
Showing management and access commonly handled via ShowingTime + Supra/Sentrilock integrated with MLS. Sources: ShowingTime MLS pages; Supra eKEY documentation.
kvCORE-Brokermint integration evidences front office/back office unification trend. Source: PRWeb release from Inside Real Estate.
inferred_but_not_confirmed: Agent counts for $5M–$50M brokerages typically range 50–400 depending on average GCI per agent and split economics. Not directly cited, inferred from industry norms.
Time savings percentages in compliance QA (30–50%) are estimated based on manual steps eliminated (PDF splitting, missing-doc chase) and vendor positioning; would need time-and-motion validation.
Lead response conversion lift (20–40%) reflects ranges reported in industry playbooks; exact lift varies by source/market.
